name: Defrost Profile Plausibility
applicable_contexts: evaporator coils in freezer or cooler zones
trigger_conditions: defrost duration or frequency not characterized
physical_basis: Defrost cycles add heat into the refrigerated space, must be removed again, and constitute a non-trivial share of refrigeration kWh. Time-initiated defrost runs whether ice has accumulated or not.
operational_basis: Demand-initiated defrost saves energy but requires sensors and controls maintenance. Default time-initiated schedules persist in older systems.
financial_mechanism: Defrost optimization is a controls-grade intervention with measurable kWh impact; missing it means equipment-first CAPEX masks a controls fix.
hypothesis: Defrost profile is a plausible loss-pattern that may be addressable with controls, not CAPEX.
minimum_evidence_to_confirm: time-initiated defrost confirmed or excessive defrost duration
falsification_conditions: demand-initiated defrost with telemetry and tuned dwell
allowed_claim_language: Defrost profile is a plausible controls-grade loss-pattern requiring validation.
escalation_conditions: controls/BAS review if no documentary evidence
claim_permissions_impact: block equipment-CAPEX-first while defrost strategy unresolved
example_outputs: Defrost initiation method is a controls-grade falsification target.
tests: cold_chain bundle should activate this when defrost strategy is missing
